receipts/ holds the lab's runs of jlevy/squares' sqverify-fast at e6e8d577, unmodified (crate source d97758bb, rustc 1.98.0, release, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu): six native streams A to F, each a successful strict subset of the net (status PARTIAL, return code 0), from which directions.jsonl.gz selects one row per direction (selection.csv), VERIFIED at all 4,972 indices 0 to 4971, least certified bound 1.0000000000003892 at direction 3663. Streams B, C and D were compacted at production to the native proof fields; their pre-compaction digests are the lab's statements.

controls/ holds every mass multiplied by 99/100, refused natively at directions 0 and 1198 (a two-direction control, not a whole-net one), and an exact rational witness at direction 1198 capturing 0.991109005346039... < 1.
exploratory/ is the lab's earlier C checker, which is not interval arithmetic, with its 4,972 VERIFIED rows; it is supplementary and not offered as evidence.

The README answers the review notes of jlevy/squares#890: the checked quadrant [L/2, U_r]^2 stands for the whole centre domain through the quarter turn and the D4-symmetric measure; the outward growth at a shared angle is m_old(t) - m_new(t)/lambda, not rho(1 - 1/lambda); the route's ceiling stays 99500/9977, with no claim for a 49,707-direction 9.97285 partial.
